jobs.role: (ASX Listed) – Sydney, Australia Property / Financial Accountant
bullets: Contract role within an ASX-listed global property group managing over $6B+ in real estate assets, supporting financial reporting and property accounting across commercial property portfolios.
Prepared month-end accounting including journals, fee calculations, invoices, reconciliations and supplier payment coding.
Produced monthly and quarterly management reporting and financial analysis.
Worked closely with Investment Management, Treasury and Development teams.
Managed full-function property accounting including lease setup and reconciliation of net property income.
Liaised with Property Management teams to resolve operational and financial queries.
Prepared bank reconciliations and receipting of tenant payments.
Monitored arrears and supported weekly payment run processes.

jobs.role: Sydney, Australia Senior Group Financial Accountant
jobs.location: Sydney, Australia Senior Group Financial Accountant
bullets: Group accounting role supporting a multi-entity storage group operating across 17 locations.
Prepared quarterly and annual financial statements including variance analysis for senior management.
Managed month-end close including journal postings, reconciliations and general ledger maintenance.
Prepared BAS returns and annual Fringe Benefits Tax returns.
Prepared covenant compliance reporting for NAB.
Conducted operational reviews across 17 sites to strengthen financial controls.
Liaised with external auditors and tax advisors during audit processes.
Conducted external audits in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards and IFRS.
Led audit planning including materiality assessments, engagement budgets and analytical procedures.
Performed risk assessment procedures and designed audit testing approaches.
Drafted reports to those charged with governance outlining audit findings and internal control issues.
Audited key financial statement line items including revenue, expenses, inventory and fixed assets.
Supported implementation of AASB 15 and AASB 16 accounting standards.
Performed walkthroughs and internal control testing to understand business processes.
Conducted inventory stocktakes and detailed fixed asset testing.
